title: 12 Best Viewpoints in Accra
description: Discover Accra's top 12 viewpoints, from panoramic rooftop bars to historic landmarks and vibrant beachfronts. Get insider tips, prices, and what to expect for breathtaking cityscapes and ocean views in Ghana's capital.

places.name: Skybar 25
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A signature cocktail like the 'Accra Sunset' or a glass of chilled champagne.

places.name: Jamestown Lighthouse
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order While there's no food inside, grab some fresh grilled fish or 'kenkey and fish' from a vendor in the Jamestown area after your visit.

places.name: Cloud 9 Rooftop Bar (Fiesta Royale Hotel)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their wood-fired pizzas are a popular choice, paired with a classic cocktail or a local beer.

places.name: Carbon Accra
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try one of their signature main courses, like the Suya Steak, and definitely indulge in a craft cocktail from their extensive bar menu.

places.name: The Gallery Bar (Kempinski Hotel Gold Coast City)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a classic cocktail or a fine glass of wine, perhaps with a selection of their gourmet cheese and charcuterie.

places.name: Santoku (Villagio Vista)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Indulge in an Omakase chef's selection or try their signature Yellowtail Sashimi with Jalapeño, paired with premium sake.

places.name: Labadi Beach Hotel (Terrace Restaurant / Beachfront)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly grilled seafood, especially their catch of the day, accompanied by local sides like jollof rice or banku.

places.name: Polo Beach Club
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their grilled prawns or a classic burger, along with a refreshing cocktail or a cold local beer.

places.name: Independence Square / Black Star Square
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order No food is served, but nearby vendors often sell fresh coconuts or local snacks.

places.name: Kwame Nkrumah Mausoleum
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order There's no food or drink served within the mausoleum itself, but there are small craft and souvenir stalls near the entrance.

places.name: Movenpick Ambassador Hotel (Pool & Garden Area)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a refreshing mocktail or cocktail by the pool, or opt for a light lunch from their poolside menu.

places.name: Buka Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their Jollof Rice with Grilled Tilapia is legendary, or try the Banku with Okro Stew for a truly local experience.
